facts.fact: 对话表态（关系）：浴后梳头时 Perla 训诫 Inés——白天冲 Bartolo 大笑是轻佻，Bartolo 家绝不会娶私生女；命她伺候自己到死、此生别想出嫁，并重提 Salvador 旧事敲打。
facts.anchor: You must take care of me until I pass away. There’ll be no wedding for you, not now.

facts.fact: 人物身世（关系）：Inés 是私生女——出生证上母亲只写了 Inés Inclán，父亲的姓氏被刻意略去，因为他是个有妇之夫。
facts.anchor: On her birth certificate her mother had written Inés Inclán, her father’s surname pointedly missing because he was a married man.

facts.fact: 转折点：Inés 替 Ulises 换床单，被手提箱蓝绸衬里吸引，发现箱角缝线松脱，从夹层掏出一捆细绳扎着的信——部分出自姨妈 Perla，多数来自其他女人。
facts.anchor: Instead, she pulled out letters, tied together with a piece of string. She sat on the floor and undid the knot, looking at the postmarks. Some of the letters were from her aunt, but most were from other women.

facts.fact: 数字与物证：其中一封信写道 Enclosed are the hundred pesos you requested（随函附上你要的一百比索）；另有一本背面登征友广告的杂志 Conmovedor，多则广告被红笔圈出。
facts.anchor: Enclosed are the hundred pesos you requested, my dear. I hope your business venture is going well and that soon we might meet.

facts.fact: 深夜对质：Inés 报出 Ulises 用过的四个化名——Ulises Linares、Ulises Orozco、Luis Cacho、Armando Zozaya，一人多名必是行骗。
facts.anchor: Ulises Linares. Ulises Orozco. Luis Cacho. Armando Zozaya.

facts.fact: 对话表态：深夜摊牌，被化名点破后 Ulises 不再抵赖，承认 Yes, I con them——靠 lonely hearts 征友广告骗女人钱，自称只赚个 a living。
facts.anchor: Her words seemed to needle him, and he replied with a voice that was insolent and smug. “Yes, I con them.”

facts.fact: 对话表态：Ulises 交底——来此是「觉得这里可能有值得偷的东西」，且 The odds are good I could, if she marries me（只要 Perla 嫁给他就得手）；Inés 当场提出 I could help you 入伙。
facts.anchor: The odds are good I could, if she marries me.

facts.fact: 转折点：他以「向姨妈告发你外甥女是扑上我床的荡妇」反威胁，Inés 仍掌掴他并下最后通牒——钱对半分（We split the money down the middle），否则他什么都得不到。
facts.anchor: She chose boldness and slapped him. He stared at her, open-mouthed, unable to utter a word, as if such an injury were inconceivable.
